description: Fallow quality baseline. Counters may shrink but not grow; averageMaintainability may rise but not drop. Regenerate with `npm run check:quality -- --update` (commit the diff in the same PR that moves the metric). 2026-07-12 (ADR 0005 sub-project 2, transcript Vue island): cloneGroups 32->36 and duplicatedLines 787->1048 rose deliberately during the migration — a few pure `rendering/*` helpers were re-implemented as Vue viewmodels (e.g. webSearchRenderer.ts <-> webSearchViewModel.ts) and the two inline plan cards (InlineExitPlanMode.vue <-> InlinePlanApproval.vue) share ~64 lines; extracting those shared clone groups is the tracked helper-extraction follow-up. The Jest-coverage-recovery follow-up (same day) relocated the surviving Vue-only pure helpers (windowedRenderSetup / visibleContentHelpers / askUserQuestionOptions / inlineChoiceCard) under ui/vue/** and deleted orphaned imperative render code (streamRenderBackoff.ts + the dead InlineChoiceList DOM class + setupWindowedRender): complexFunctions improved 226->225 (dead class methods gone), and averageMaintainability drifted 90.2->90.1 — a benign averaging artifact of removing above-average-maintainability dead files, not any file getting less maintainable.
